description:
intent=i044 snapshot=s01 branch=hardirq-shared-lock status=complete
finding location=drivers/usb/gadget/udc/fusb300_udc.c:1059-1071 confidence=medium conclusion=fusb300_udc.c hardirq handler fusb300_irq (request_irq:1424) takes fusb300->lock plainly (1071) while non-irq paths also use plain spin_lock (720/877/1207) and only some sites use irqsave - mixed-discipline hardirq-shared lock, potential interrupt-context lockup; medium confidence.
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/mediatek/mtk_star_emac.c:770-786 confidence=medium conclusion=mtk_star_emac.c hardirq handler takes priv->lock plainly (783) and the same lock is taken plainly by NAPI-poll completion paths (1186/1352) with hard IRQs enabled - hardirq can preempt and spin forever; medium-confidence DoS.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/seeq/sgiseeq.c:512 conclusion=Verify whether sgiseeq.c sp->tx_lock has any process-context or softirq-context acquisition without irq-disable; if none, classify safe.
unresolved location=sound/pci/echoaudio/echoaudio.c:1849 conclusion=Read echoaudio.c around 1849/1864 to determine whether the plain handler acquisitions are inside irqsave regions or constitute the irq-side of a mixed-discipline defect.
unresolved location=drivers/tty/serial/mps2-uart.c:192 conclusion=Trace mps2-uart.c port->lock non-irq acquisitions (startup/shutdown/set_termios) and confirm whether any is plain; if all are irqsave, classify safe.
unresolved location=drivers/dma/ipu/ipu_idmac.c:1171 conclusion=Trace ipu_idmac.c non-irq acquisitions of ipu_data.lock/ichan->lock and check whether any plain process/softirq holder exists against the hardirq side.
coverage_gap=Handler-lock extraction covered 1109 of 1458 unique hardirq handler names (defs not resolved for 349, mostly multi-file or macro-declared handlers); those unresolved handlers' lock usage was not examined.
coverage_gap=Cross-indexing matched lock expressions only within the registering file; locks shared across files (e.g. via exported helpers) or declared with different expressions (e.g. &priv->lock vs &dev->lock aliases) could be missed.
coverage_gap=candidates table leaves sgiseeq.c, echoaudio.c, mps2-uart.c, ipu_idmac.c unclassified beyond initial signal; other top cross.tsv rows (zs.c, emxx_udc, isp1760, net2280, mv_u3d, goku_udc, net2272, ravb) were spot-checked for mixed discipline but not deeply read.
artifact=findings/i044.json
